bullets.text: Pornhub Uses Apple Verification - **Pornhub** adopts **Apple's** age verification feature to comply with UK regulations.
CarPlay Allows Video Playback - **Apple** introduces video playback in **CarPlay** for parked vehicles starting with iOS 26.
New Wallet Feature in iOS 27 - **Apple Wallet** will allow users to create digital passes from physical QR codes.
AI Economy Faces Bottlenecks - Experts discuss challenges in the **AI** supply chain at the Milken Global Conference.
Snap Ends Perplexity Deal - **Snap** amicably terminates its $400M partnership with **Perplexity** amid integration challenges.
Microsoft's Clean Energy Goals at Risk - **Microsoft** debates scaling back its clean energy targets due to AI data center demands.
Corgi Valuation Hits $1.3B - Insurance startup **Corgi** secures $160M Series B, reaching a valuation of $1.3 billion.
DeepSeek's Valuation Soars - **DeepSeek** could reach a $45B valuation as it seeks its first venture capital round.
Braintrust Confirms Security Breach - **Braintrust** advises customers to rotate API keys after confirming unauthorized access.
Qualcomm Launches New Chips - **Qualcomm** unveils midrange chips with **Wi-Fi 7** support, enhancing gaming for budget phones.
